newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower in thin dealings.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower in thin dealings.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower in thin dealings with the market continuing to hold within a tight trading range, traders said.
"It was light volume, a slow day," a trader said.
There were no changes in fundamentals with the U.S. domestic cash market holding firm while overseas markets display a weak undertone, they said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 150 contracts, below the 797 traded Friday, according to the CBOT.
Rice futures closed 3-1/2 to four cents per cwt lower, with January down four at $10.61 per cwt.
